ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) base comprising approximately 85% of the surface area, punctuated by localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters making up approximately 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base dark pigmentation is contiguous. High-contrast white geometric blobs are organized as discrete circular rosettes (10-30 pixel diameter) scattered across both lobes, with a dense region of white mottling and linear striations on the distal portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees, showing a well-defined vertex at the center-point of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels; the topography exhibits a jagged saw-tooth pattern along the entire continuous boundary from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast white circular/annular clusters distributed globally; prominent clusters are located in the central-left and central-right regions of the ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of unaligned, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions; specifically, a series of parallel vertical/diagonal white lines (rake marks) are visible on the upper quadrant of the right lobe and near the trailing edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring from barnacle attachment (rosettes) and linear rake marks (likely inter-species interaction marks) visible across the entire visible ventral area.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-intensity white marbling/mottling at the extreme lateral tip of the right lobe, contrasting sharply with the primary dark pigmentation.
